name: @workhorse/core
description: Evidence-first PostgreSQL durable job queue validation MVP

scripts.build: pnpm build:runtime && pnpm docs:build && pnpm --filter @workhorse/demo build
scripts.build:runtime:dev: pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter @workhorse/dashboard build:library && pnpm --filter @workhorse/drizzle build && pnpm --filter @workhorse/hono build
scripts.demo:app: pnpm db:reset:demo && pnpm build:runtime:dev && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx scripts/dev.ts
scripts.signoz:up: foundryctl cast --file ops/signoz/casting.yaml --pours ops/signoz/pours && tsx scripts/signoz-portless.ts add
scripts.signoz:down: docker compose -f ops/signoz/pours/deployment/compose.yaml down && tsx scripts/signoz-portless.ts remove
scripts.build:core: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && rm -rf dist/sql && cp -R sql dist/sql
scripts.typecheck: pnpm typecheck:core && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json --noEmit && pnpm build:runtime && pnpm --filter './packages/*' typecheck && pnpm --filter @workhorse/demo typecheck && pnpm docs:typecheck
scripts.test:integration: tsx scripts/with-env.ts node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run test/integration.test.ts
scripts.test:site-smoke: pnpm docs:build && tsx scripts/with-env.ts tsx test/site-smoke.ts
scripts.lint: oxlint --deny-warnings --import-plugin --vitest-plugin --ignore-pattern apps/site/next-env.d.ts src test benchmarks packages apps demo scripts vitest.config.ts
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --fix --import-plugin --vitest-plugin --ignore-pattern apps/site/next-env.d.ts src test benchmarks packages apps demo scripts vitest.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:packed && pnpm test:site-smoke && pnpm test:demo-smoke
scripts.db:reset:all: pnpm db:reset:dev && pnpm db:reset:test && pnpm db:reset:bench && pnpm db:reset:demo
